d: Long, flowing charcoal-black hair with blunt-cut bangs and a slight center part frames a youthful, adolescent face with wide, shimmering crimson eyes. The slender build is dressed in a navy blue sleeveless crop top featuring a white sailor-style collar and a bright red neckerchief, paired with a short, pleated white skirt accented by a thin red line along the hem. A brown leather belt cinches the waist, and the look is completed with black fingerless gloves and olive-drab mechanical armor plating mounted on the shoulders.
